1.5.valor: 1. Deficiencies in the maintenance and inspection of the vehicle restraint system of the overpass. 2. The structure of the vehicle and its position on the tracks after falling from the overpass facilitated the train derailment. 3. The switch 2/4 had an impact on the consequences of the derailment of the power head vehicle, acting as a guide rail. 4. The collision of the power head vehicle against a stack of railway sleepers increased the damage suffered by the train drivers. Systemic contributing factors: 5. Lack of awareness of the potential dangers of inappropriate maintenance of vehicle restraint systems. 6. Procedures to regulate on-site inspection of overpasses by ADIF are required. 7. Overpasses on conventional lines are not equipped with falling objects systems.
1.5.cita: Contributing factors: 1. Deficiencies in the maintenance and inspection of the vehicle restraint system of the overpass.
